concepts.title: ACTIVATION PROCEDURE
concepts.description: Provides step-by-step activation commands, preconditions, rollout recommendations, and verification procedures for Cascaded RET Support.

concepts.title: DEACTIVATION PROCEDURE
concepts.description: Step-by-step procedure and operational considerations for deactivating the Cascaded RET Support feature.

concepts.title: FEATURE DEPEDENCIES
concepts.description: Outlines the feature, hardware, and network dependencies, as well as limitations, for Cascaded RET Support.

concepts.title: FEATURE OPERATION
concepts.description: Describes the operational process for Cascaded RET Support, including AISG bus scanning, ALD discovery, device calibration, electrical tilt control, and continuous supervision.

concepts.title: FEATURE OVERVIEW
concepts.description: Overview of Cascaded RET Support extending node Remote Electrical Tilt control to daisy-chained AISG devices.

concepts.title: Network Impact
concepts.description: Details the impact of Cascaded RET Support on network coverage, end users, O&M load, and site operations.

concepts.title: Parameters
concepts.description: Parameters governing bus scanning behavior and per-device tilt control for Cascaded RET Support.

concepts.title: Performance Management
concepts.description: Defines performance management principles, KPIs, and PM counters for monitoring Cascaded RET hardware health and AISG bus integrity.
